title: Lost Kids WB Classic Is Finally Coming to Streaming After 23 Years
content: A lost classic from the Kids WB! Saturday morning cartoons library is finally set to make its streaming debut after 23 long years, and it’s going to be available totally for free. Tubi has been making great strides in the past year especially to make Warner Bros.

title: New Fantasy Isekai Confirms Winter 2027 Launch With First Look Trailer – Watch
content: A new fantasy isekai confirms the Winter 2027 lineup with a new trailer. Now that 2026 is finally closer to its end, the 2027 anime lineup is getting broader by the day. It’s evident so far that it will be yet another exciting year for anime fans.

title: After 15 Years, Surprise Action Series Confirms Return With New Anime Revival
content: A classic action series has surprisingly announced it’s coming back with a new anime revival to help celebrate its 15th anniversary. If you are of a certain age, you might have noticed how there have been many classic anime and manga franchises coming back with new anime adaptations .
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix’s One Piece Season 3 Readies for Launch With New Behind-the-Scenes Teases
content: One Piece ‘s live-action series is fast approaching its return to Netflix next year, and it’s one step closer to that launch with the start of a new wave of behind-the-scenes videos showing off more of the series’ production.
author: ComicBook

title: Major Shonen Jump Series Officially Ends After 6 Years With Final Release
content: Another major series has ended its run in the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine after six years of serialization with the release of its final chapter, and it makes the 14th title coming to an end this year overall.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen' Creator Launches New Manga
content: The 52nd issue of Weekly Shounen Jump magazine began serializing a new manga by Hitsuji Gondaira , titled Ginza Uradoori Kouban no Hizuki-san ( Hizuki of the Ginza Patrol ), on Monday. This marks Gondaira's return to serialization in nearly two years following the end of Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen in January 2025.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Manga 'Sakamoto Days' Concludes Serialization
content: Yuuto Suzuki 's Sakamoto Days manga has concluded with chapter 284 in the 52nd issue of Weekly Shounen Jump magazine on Monday, after 6-year serialization. Suzuki originally drew the action comedy manga as a one-shot in Jump GIGA magazine in December 2019.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Witch on the Holy Night Film Expands 981 Cuts for ScreenX Release
content: The official website for the Witch on the Holy Night ( Mahōtsukai no Yoru ) anime film announced on Sunday that the film will begin playing in the premium formats ScreenX, Ultra 4DX, Dolby Cinema, 4DX, and MX4D in Japan this Friday, November 27.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Fall 2026 Anime Has Become the Perfect Zombie Anime
content: Crunchyroll ‘s darkest anime of Fall 2026 has become a zombie anime with the ideal setup, complementing the series’ premise and making it even spookier and scarier. The zombie genre is famous across all forms of media, regardless of how it is presented.

title: Nahato's 'The One. Later On...' Light Novels Get TV Anime in 2027
content: A website opened on Sunday to announce the television anime adaptation of Nahato 's Sono Mono. Nochi ni... ( The One. Later On... ) light novel series which will premiere in 2027. The website also presented a teaser visual and the anime's main cast and staff members.
author: ANN
